meta.name: Nauči AI — platform DNA (the skin)
meta.description: Design identity of the nauciai.com learning platform. This is the IDENTITY half of the Studio fusion: Studio must read as this app from the first frame. Neo-brutalist, hand-drawn warmth, hard offset shadows, cream paper, one dark-blue ink, one yellow accent. Extracted from app/globals.css, components/ui/primitives.tsx, components/app/app-sidebar.tsx, AGENTS.md.

primary.role: ink — text, all borders (border-2 border-ink), dark CTA fill, structural everything

secondary.role: muted — secondary text, help copy, metadata

accent.role: yellow — reserved for ACTION and emphasis only (primary CTA fill, sketch-icon chips, hand-underline, ::selection, shadow offset on ink buttons). Never decorative filler.

neutral.usage: Two grounds only: cream #fffdf8 for the page, white #ffffff for cards/surfaces. #c9d4df for the rare hairline. Everything structural is ink.

semantic.success: #0e3158 on #f4be30 or a green not yet tokenized — success is usually shown structurally, not chromatically
semantic.error: red used inline for form errors (not a global token; role='alert' text)

surface.elevated: #ffffff with a larger hard offset shadow (no blur)

color.contrast_strategy: High-contrast dark-on-light dominant. Ink #0e3158 on cream/white is ~11:1. Contrast is carried by BORDER + SHADOW, not by tonal layering. There is no gray-scale elevation ramp — depth is a hard-edged offset shadow, not a blur.

overline.size: font-display 1.25rem (Patrick Hand kicker) — hand-drawn, not an uppercase tracked overline

font_families.heading: Nunito (700–900) for structural headings; Patrick Hand (font-display) for kickers/hand-drawn accents

typography.font_style_notes: Rounded humanist sans (Nunito) carrying most weight, paired with a genuine handwriting face (Patrick Hand) used sparingly for personality. letter-spacing is forced to 0 everywhere (body, button, a, input, textarea, select). Weight is the primary hierarchy lever — font-black (900) is used liberally, even on 12px tooltips. Friendly, high-energy, confident.

spacing.content_density: comfortable — generous padding inside cards (px-5/px-6, py-2.5/py-3 on buttons), roomy sections
spacing.section_rhythm: Large vertical gaps between marketing sections; inside the app, medium rhythm. Cards breathe (16px card radius wants ≥12–16px inner padding).

layout.grid_system: Flex/CSS-grid, no formal 12-col token. App shell = sidebar (rail 80px / expanded 280–420px) + main, .shell-container centers and at ≥1600px main clamps to max-width 1380px
layout.max_content_width: 1380px (app main at ultra-wide), 3xl/max-w-3xl for reading columns
layout.breakpoints: sm 640, md 768 (sidebar desktop threshold), lg 1024 (resize handle), xl 1280, 1600 (shell widen)
layout.alignment_tendency: mixed — strict left alignment for app chrome, centered heroes for marketing

border_radius.large: 16px (surface-card) — the default for any bordered element via @layer base
border_radius.pill: 9999px (rounded-full — all buttons by default, chips, badges, avatars)

shape.border_usage: bold borders — border-2 (2px) border-ink is the signature; occasional border-[3px]. Borders are structural and omnipresent, not subtle. Inputs, cards, chips, buttons all carry the ink border.
shape.divider_style: either the ink border-2 itself, or a 1px #c9d4df (--line) hairline for quiet separation

elevation.shadow_style: hard drop — ZERO blur, solid color, offset only. The defining trait. e.g. shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_#f4be30], shadow-[6px_6px_0_0_rgba(14,49,88,0.13)]
elevation.depth_cues: hard offset shadow + bold border. Depth reads as a physical paper cutout, not as light/blur. Hover deepens the offset (4→6px) and lifts the element (-translate-y-0.5).

iconography.style: lucide-react line icons, consistent stroke, occasionally placed inside a yellow bordered SketchIcon chip

motion.entrance_pattern: fade + small rise (autoAlpha 0, y:10) with a 0.04s stagger via .sidebar-reveal; motion/react AnimatePresence for accordions
motion.philosophy: minimal functional with playful accents — motion confirms and delights but never blocks. data-motion attribute system tags elements (interactive/card/copy/scribble/circle). prefers-reduced-motion is globally honored (all durations forced to 0.01ms).

components.button_style: Pill (rounded-full), border-2 border-ink, font-extrabold. Three tones: ink (bg-ink text-white, yellow hard shadow), yellow (bg-yellow text-ink, ink hard shadow), paper (bg-white text-ink, soft ink shadow). Hover: -translate-y-0.5 and shadow grows 4→6px. min-h-11/12.
components.input_style: border-2 border-ink, 12px radius (bordered-control-radius via @layer base), bg-white, sits on cream. Clear focus-visible outline.
components.card_style: Panel = rounded-[16px] border-2 border-ink bg-white shadow-[6px_6px_0_0_rgba(14,49,88,0.13)]. The paper-cutout card is the atom of the whole UI.
components.navigation_pattern: Left sidebar (hand-rolled aside): collapsible to an 80px icon rail with right-side tooltips; mobile off-canvas drawer + a 4-slot bottom tab bar. NavLink rows, NavDisclosure accordions.
components.modal_style: White Panel card, ink border, hard shadow, over a scrim; drawer variant uses role=dialog + focus trap
components.list_style: Nav rows with active state (filled/bordered), disclosure groups with grid-rows expand
components.component_notes: cn() is a plain class-join (NOT tailwind-merge) — earlier classes cannot be overridden by caller className, so variants are resolved inside the component. Authored rounded-* always wins over the @layer base defaults; NEVER use ! or inline borderRadius to force a corner. Repo has NO shadcn and NO radix — components/ui is a hand-written primitives.tsx.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a well-made paper workbook / sketchbook — printed ink on cream stock, cut-out cards casting hard little shadows, hand-drawn marks in the margin
aesthetic.era_influence: contemporary neo-brutalism softened by 90s craft-workbook warmth

visual_language.ornamentation: subtle accents — hand-drawn underlines (HandUnderline), yellow sketch-icon chips, optional sketch-grid / ink-hatch textures; restrained overall
visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous but structured; cream ground reads as calm space between inked cards
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: heavy borders and black type give strong, even weight; yellow is the only thing allowed to pull focus, so it is rationed
visual_language.focal_strategy: single strong CTA per view via yellow/ink contrast; distributed card interest elsewhere
visual_language.texture_usage: occasional flat CSS textures (sketch-grid dotted grid, ink-hatch diagonal hatch) at very low opacity

composition.hierarchy_method: weight contrast (font-black vs muted) + border/shadow prominence + rationed yellow
composition.balance_type: asymmetric within cards, symmetric for hero moments
composition.flow_direction: top-down, left-aligned reading; CTA anchors the eye
composition.grouping_strategy: bordered cards as hard containers — grouping is explicit, drawn, not implied by whitespace alone
composition.negative_space_role: the cream ground is active negative space that makes inked cards pop

imagery.photo_treatment: photos/media sit inside bordered cards; historically image containers also carry the ink frame
imagery.illustration_style: hand-drawn line accents, scribble underlines, marker-like strokes
imagery.graphic_elements: hard offset shadows, 2px ink borders, yellow chips, hand underlines, dotted sketch grid
imagery.pattern_usage: minimal — hatch/grid textures used as quiet background flavor only
imagery.image_shape: rounded rectangles on the sanctioned radius scale; media at 8px (surface-media), half the card radius

interaction_feel.feedback_style: physical and immediate — press lifts the element and deepens its shadow, like pressing a paper tab
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: -translate-y-0.5 lift + shadow offset grows (4→6px); tooltips fade in on the rail
interaction_feel.transition_personality: snappy with a touch of bounce
interaction_feel.loading_style: honest inline states; role=status announcements; skeletons/spinners kept simple
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: moderate — enough to feel alive, never busy

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: friendly, plain-spoken, encouraging — teaches, never lectures
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: warm and useful — a short human sentence plus (usually) one concrete next action; drops the CTA when no action would actually help
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: human, non-technical, no raw codes on screen — tells the learner what to do next

overview.fallback_strategy: reduce to CSS; prefers-reduced-motion globally forces near-zero durations
overview.primary_technology: CSS + GSAP + motion/react (both already in package.json)

background_effects.type: flat CSS texture (dotted sketch-grid, diagonal ink-hatch) — optional, very low opacity
background_effects.description: sketch-grid: two crossed linear-gradients at 28px creating a 6%-ink dotted grid; ink-hatch: repeating -18deg 8%-ink hatch

text_effects.description: hand-underline SVG sits under key words but text itself is not animated per-glyph

image_effects.description: cards lift and deepen shadow on hover; no image distortion

params.blur_radius: 0 — the aesthetic is explicitly anti-blur (hard shadows)

svg_animations.description: HandUnderline is a static two-stroke SVG scribble (yellow + ink); could be path-drawn on reveal

visual_effects.composite_notes: The platform's entire 'effect' vocabulary is hard-edged paper physics: 2px ink borders, zero-blur offset shadows, a rationed yellow, and hand-drawn SVG marks. There is deliberately NO glass, NO blur, NO glow, NO particle/3D wizardry. For Studio this is the crucial constraint: the trick Flow uses to make media readable (a black room) is unavailable, and the platform offers no dark surface or blur to hide behind — media must be made calm by containment (its own dark media well inside a card), rhythm, and restraint, not by effects.
